comment: Original Xbox build inputs (tools/xbox_build.py). The game's sources, defines and include directories are the Linux build's (port/linux/port.json); this lists the other ports' platform units the Xbox shares (Linux's Winsock layer over port/xbox/src/nxdk_net.c's lwIP sockets), and the Windows ones it compiles against nxdk's Windows API. See port/xbox/README.md. include_symbols are linked in by name: nxdk's automount of D: to the XBE's folder.
